beats.line: Ready to leave the pavement behind?
Your weekend ride deserves more than just smooth roads. Regular boards can't handle the real trails.
Meet the Rover Off-Roader. Built for the ride to everywhere. It takes on any terrain.

Its deep-treaded tires grip pavement, grass, and dirt. Twin 350W hub motors climb slopes up to 10 degrees. Glide for 8 to 10 km on a single charge. Charge up fully in just 150 minutes. It holds up to 100 kg easily. All this for just ₹24,999. That's a saving from ₹32,000.
beats.on_screen: Range, speed, charge vary by conditions.

beats.line: Ready for your next adventure? Visit Radboards.in to explore the Rover.
